lifecycleScripts.afterStart: wp-env run cli -- wp option set woocommerce_store_address '60 29th Street' --quiet 2>/dev/null; wp-env run cli -- wp option set woocommerce_store_city 'San Francisco' --quiet 2>/dev/null; wp-env run cli -- wp option set woocommerce_default_country 'US:CA' --quiet 2>/dev/null; wp-env run cli -- wp option set woocommerce_store_postcode '94110' --quiet 2>/dev/null; wp-env run cli -- wp option set woocommerce_currency 'USD' --quiet 2>/dev/null; echo 'WooCommerce Stripe dev environment ready at http://localhost:8072'
